reviews.author: Nisha Reddy
reviews.title: Smooth Consultation
reviews.body: Pehli baar maine relocation ke baare me question kiya tha. useful guidance mili aur baat balanced lagi. career ka bhi mention mila. Kundali points dekhkar doubts kaafi clear hue 😊

reviews.author: Simran Naidu
reviews.title: Clear Advice
reviews.body: Pehli baar maine job switch ke baare me samajhna chaha tha. kaafi relatable laga aur response genuine laga. investment ka bhi mention mila. End me kundali summary dekhkar acha laga 😊

reviews.author: Yash Jain
reviews.title: Valuable Advice
reviews.body: Recently maine savings ke baare me detail me baat ki thi. confidence mila aur points practical lage. family peace ka bhi mention mila. Closing summary simple aur samajhne layak thi.
